principal.title: Hong Sambath
body: It is my great pleasure and honor to warmly welcome you to Future Kids International School, a school founded on love, care, and a strong commitment to providing high-quality education through our philosophy of "Education with Love" for every child.

As an educator and a mother, I deeply understand that the early years of a child’s life are one of the most important stages for building character, developing good habits and values, and laying the foundation for lifelong learning.

Therefore, our core educational philosophy is “Education with Love.” We believe that children who grow up with love, respect, and care will develop into confident individuals with good character and the ability to pursue their dreams. At Future Kids International School, we do more than teach children numbers, letters, and academic knowledge.

We focus on nurturing good character, mutual respect, independence, sharing, cooperation, and a love of learning. Through our Montessori Curriculum and Bilingual Program, we strive to provide meaningful learning experiences that support children’s holistic development physically, mentally, intellectually, emotionally, and socially.The school is committed to creating a safe, warm, joyful, and loving environment where children feel that school is their second home.

At the same time, we believe that love is the foundation of education. Therefore, we are committed to working closely with parents to create the best possible environment for every child’s growth and learning.

I sincerely thank you for your trust and support in entrusting your beloved children to our care and education. We will continue to fulfill our mission with the highest level of responsibility and with the same love and care that we would give to our own children.

history.title: School History
body: At Future Kids School, we believe every child deserves the best foundation for a successful future.

We combine international early years education standards with the benefits of outdoor learning, creativity, and environmental awareness to nurture confident, curiousity, and caring young learners, Future Kids School was created with a commitment to providing high-quality education in a warm, inspiring, and green learning environment.

Our purpose-built campus encourages children to explore, play, discover, and grow through meaningful experiences both inside and outside. We take pride in creating a safe and welcoming atmosphere where every child feels valued, comfortable, and supported.
With a personal approach, small community environment, and dedicated educators, every child is known by name and every family becomes part of the Future Kids community.

whyChooseUs.title: Why Choose Us
whyChooseUs.body: We offer a high-quality Montessori education that nurtures each child's curiosity, independence, confidence, and love of learning. Through a carefully prepared environment, hands-on experiences, and dedicated guidance from our educators, children develop essential skills and a strong foundation for lifelong success.

items.labs: Sand Play Area, Biking & Mini Garden
items.cafeteria: A Safe and Green Place to Grow

items.text: Dedicated educators who inspire, guide, and support every child’s unique development through personalized care and meaningful learning experiences.
Our Montessori approach nurtures the whole child by fostering independence, creativity, confidence, and lifelong learning through a thoughtfully prepared environment

Conveniently located on 7Makara Road, just outside the heart of Siem Reap, our school is easily accessible within a short drive from all areas of the city, providing families with a convenient and comfortable daily journey.

A peaceful and nature-inspired campus where children feel safe, relaxed, and inspired to learn through enriching outdoor experiences, including adventure walks, playgrounds, sports areas, animal habitats, sand areas and organic gardening.

principalPhoto.title: Information Office
body: Our information office is happy to welcome you and ready to help. We provide information and advice about our Montessori study programs and how to enroll your child.

Our team is dedicated to giving you clear, professional, and caring service. We want to help you choose a safe, high-quality learning environment that fits your child's growth and overall development.
We warmly welcome you and your family to visit our campus, and we look forward to meeting you soon!

curriculum.title: Designed with care
curriculum.body: In Green tradition, this campus has a very welcoming and natural.  A relaxing atmosphere where children can feel comfortable and enjoy their learning environment. With features like a adventure walk, two playgrounds, tortoise habitat and organic garden the children get a chance to experience the outdoors throughout their learning experience. As a central part of our philosophy is to provide a better future for our children, even our school was designed with sustainable ideology in mind. Our structures made from recycled shipping containers, we create solar power, and leave plenty of natural green space outside for everyone to enjoy.
